---
title: "Palmer Penguins Dashboard"
author: "Faith K Muller"
format: dashboard 
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins <- penguins
```

# Data Graphs

## Row 1

```{r, warning=FALSE}
mass_by_island <- ggplot(penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
bill_by_island <- ggplot(penguins, aes(island, bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(bill_by_island)
```

## Row 2 {.tabset}

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| title: Flipper Length by Mass
flipper_length_by_mass <- ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, colour = species)) +
  geom_point()

ggplotly(flipper_length_by_mass)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| title: Bill Length by Mass
bill_length_by_mass <- ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, bill_length_mm, colour = species)) +
  geom_point()

ggplotly(bill_length_by_mass)
```

# Data Table

This dataset describes 344 individual penguins and come from the 'palmerpenguins' package. These three species of penguins lives on the different islands in the Palmer Archipelago.

```{r}
penguins <- penguins |>
  select(-c(year))

knitr::kable(penguins)
```
